intro: The Harissa Avocado Bowl is one of the most popular options on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls), combining bold Mediterranean flavors with protein-rich ingredients. Priced between $13.95 and $14.95, this signature bowl features spicy Harissa Honey Chicken, creamy avocado, and tangy Lemon Herb Tahini over a nutritious brown rice base. With 830 calories and 41g of protein, it delivers a satisfying, balanced meal that keeps customers coming back.
priceCalories: The Harissa Avocado Bowl costs between $13.95 and $14.95 depending on your location, making it a mid-range option on the [full CAVA menu](/). At 830 calories per serving, it provides substantial energy for an active lifestyle. The bowl delivers 41g of protein for muscle support, 62g of carbohydrates for sustained energy, and 49g of healthy fats primarily from avocado and tahini, creating a well-rounded nutritional profile.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this bowl apart is the perfect balance of heat and sweetness from the Harissa Honey Chicken paired with cooling, creamy avocado. The combination of smoky harissa sauce, tangy pickled onions, and rich Lemon Herb Tahini creates layers of complex flavor. Unlike basic bowls, this curated option features thoughtfully selected ingredients from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) that complement each other perfectly.
nutritionFacts: Each Harissa Avocado Bowl contains 830 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 41g protein, 62g carbohydrates, and 49g fat. The protein comes primarily from the grilled chicken, while healthy fats are supplied by fresh avocado, hummus, and tahini. Brown rice provides complex carbohydrates and fiber for sustained energy. This nutrient-dense meal offers essential vitamins, minerals, and heart-healthy monounsaturated fats without artificial ingredients or preservatives.
whatsInside: This signature bowl starts with a base of nutty brown rice, topped with tender Harissa Honey Chicken as the protein. Creamy hummus and fresh avocado add richness, while spicy harissa sauce brings heat. Tangy pickled onions provide acidity and crunch, and the whole bowl is finished with silky Lemon Herb Tahini dressing. Every ingredient works together to create a harmonious Mediterranean-inspired meal with bold, memorable flavors.
tasteLike: The Harissa Avocado Bowl offers a dynamic flavor experience that balances spicy, sweet, tangy, and creamy notes. The Harissa Honey Chicken delivers a pleasant kick with subtle sweetness, while the cool avocado and rich hummus mellow the heat. Pickled onions add bright acidity that cuts through the richness. The Lemon Herb Tahini brings everything together with its nutty, herbal finish, creating a satisfying taste that is both bold and balanced.
customize: While this is a curated bowl, you can customize it to your preferences at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). Add extra protein, swap brown rice for a different option from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), or include additional toppings from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) like feta or cucumbers. You can also adjust spice levels, request extra avocado, or add a side from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) to complete your meal.
pairsWell: This hearty bowl pairs excellently with lighter sides and refreshing beverages. Consider adding a crisp side salad or pita chips for extra crunch. For drinks, sparkling water or unsweetened iced tea complement the bold flavors without overwhelming them. If you want more protein, add a side of falafel. The bowl is filling on its own but works well with items from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) for a complete dining experience.
healthyChoice: The Harissa Avocado Bowl is a nutritious choice that provides balanced macronutrients and wholesome ingredients. With 41g of protein, it supports muscle maintenance and satiety. The avocado and tahini provide heart-healthy fats, while brown rice offers fiber and complex carbs. At 830 calories, it is a substantial meal suitable for active individuals. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how it fits your dietary goals and explore modifications.
howToOrder: Order the Harissa Avocado Bowl in-store at any CAVA location, through the CAVA mobile app, or via their website for pickup or delivery. Simply select it from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and customize if desired. The bowl comes pre-configured with all signature ingredients, but you can add extras or make substitutions. Available during all operating hours, it is prepared fresh to order with quality Mediterranean ingredients.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Chicken + Rice Bowl at 700 calories and $12.85-$13.45, the Harissa Avocado Bowl offers more calories and bold harissa flavor with avocado. The Spicy Lamb + Avocado Bowl provides similar heat at 800 calories but costs $14.95-$16.25. The Falafel Crunch Bowl delivers 860 calories at $13.45-$14.45 with a vegetarian profile. For lighter options, consider the Greek Salad Bowl at 580 calories and comparable pricing.
whoShouldTry: This bowl is perfect for spice lovers who enjoy bold Mediterranean flavors and crave satisfying, protein-rich meals. Active individuals and fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the 41g of protein and balanced macros. Those who love the combination of heat and creamy textures should definitely try it. Anyone exploring the [full CAVA menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for the first time will find this signature bowl represents the brand well with its vibrant, fresh ingredients.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone who enjoys flavorful, nutritious Mediterranean cuisine. The Harissa Avocado Bowl delivers restaurant-quality taste with fresh, wholesome ingredients at a reasonable price point. Its balanced nutrition profile makes it suitable for various dietary preferences, while the bold flavors ensure a memorable dining experience. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-time visitor, this signature bowl showcases what makes CAVA special in the fast-casual Mediterranean space.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the CAVA Harissa Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: The Harissa Avocado Bowl contains 830 calories per serving, with 41g of protein, 62g of carbohydrates, and 49g of fat. This makes it a substantial, balanced meal suitable for active lifestyles and those seeking a protein-rich lunch or dinner option.

faqs.q: What comes in the Harissa Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: The bowl includes Harissa Honey Chicken, brown rice, hummus, harissa sauce, fresh avocado, pickled onions, and Lemon Herb Tahini dressing. All ingredients are prepared fresh and combine to create a flavorful Mediterranean meal with a balance of protein, healthy fats, and complex carbohydrates.

faqs.q: How much does the Harissa Avocado Bowl cost?
faqs.a: The Harissa Avocado Bowl is priced between $13.95 and $14.95 depending on your location. This mid-range pricing reflects the quality ingredients including fresh avocado and grilled chicken, making it a competitive value for a nutritious, filling meal.

faqs.q: Is the Harissa Avocado Bowl spicy?
faqs.a: Yes, the bowl has moderate heat from both the Harissa Honey Chicken and harissa sauce. However, the spiciness is balanced by cooling elements like fresh avocado, creamy hummus, and rich Lemon Herb Tahini, making it enjoyable even for those with moderate spice tolerance.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Harissa Avocado Bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize this curated bowl by adding or removing ingredients, changing the base, adjusting protein portions, or requesting extra toppings. Visit the CAVA Nutrition Calculator to see how modifications affect the nutritional content and create your perfect personalized bowl.
